newsitem.title: USA: SDL sees Q2 loss of $30 mln after charge.
newsitem.headline: SDL sees Q2 loss of $30 mln after charge.

text.p: SDL Inc said Monday it expects to report a net loss of about $30 million after one-time charges for its second quarter.

The company said it expects to report operating income of about $1 million for the quarter ended June 30, and that the company will post one-time charges of about $31 million relating mainly to the settlement of a lawsuit with Spectra-Physics AB.
In the comparable year-ago quarter SDL had profits of $2.43 million, or $0.20 a share.

The company said in a statement it expects revenues for the quarter will be about the same as the $21.6 million in reported in the comparable year-ago period and slightly above the $21 million in revenues it had in its first quarter.

SDL attributed the weaker than expected revenues to a longer than expected qualification process by some customers for one of its pump module products. Also margins were lower due to higher costs incurred to expand wafer fabrication capacity.
The company said it believes it will resume revenue growth in the second half of 1997.
Analysts had predicted SDL would have operating profits of $0.06 a share in the second quarter, according to First Call.
